notes: Measured position: byte 14 of 68. Encoding read from the breakout box: the byte is split by a dotted rule into two nibbles, each with its own leader and its own bracketed list. Leaders followed by eye: the LEFT-hand nibble leads to 0=Duplex OFF / 1=Duplex- / 2=Duplex+ / 3=RPS; the RIGHT-hand nibble leads to 0=OFF .. 7=TONE(T)/TSQL(R). Printed below: a circled-i note reading RPS can be set when DD mode is selected, and Duplex (+, -) can be set when other than DD mode is selected. The dash in 1=Duplex- is drawn as a mid-height bar noticeably wider than the hyphen in (+, -); a raster cannot fix its codepoint, so it is transcribed as a plain hyphen and the difference recorded in the .md.

visual_anchor: Last bracket of the lower row of the data block on PDF page 19, over the elided white run at its right-hand end; the values are on PDF page 20, in the two tables headed - Character codes— Letters and Numbers and - Character codes— Symbols under the bold heading • Codes for character entries in the left-hand column.
notes: Measured position (PDF page 19): bytes 53-68 of 68; drawn elided: two solid X:X cells with a dashed-outline cell containing a five-dot ellipsis between them, all three cells white. Both indices are printed as circled numerals, but no Unicode circled form exists above 50, so they are transcribed as plain digits. Encoding: the referenced tables are headed ASCII code and map each character to that code. Values are listed in printed table order, each printed row contributing its left-hand pair then its right-hand pair; the Letters and Numbers table has a fourth cell struck through with a diagonal rule and no entry. The glyphs printed against codes 22, 27 and 60 are typographic (curly / grave) forms rather than the straight ASCII glyphs those codes denote, and the glyph against 2D is a mid-height bar wider than a hyphen; transcribed as drawn where the raster allows, with 2D given as a plain hyphen. The tables print no entry for a space character. The section header prints Command: 1A 00, 1A 05 01 79, 02 71, 02 74 ~ 02 77, 02 80 ~ 02 83, 02 91, 02 93, 02 94, 03 05, 03 08, 03 20, 03 28.
